text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Cheese 'n crackers! I won! Runn'n with
ev'ryth'n
you've got really does pay off!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And here I was think'n I was up a creek
without a
paddle! Hot dog, what a rush!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep, there's noth'n like a hard-earned
vict'ry t'put
some pep in your step!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From all the country slang coming out of
her, it's
clear Yukino Bijin is very
excited.

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm pretty pleased with that
performance!
I feel like I've really
improved!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All righty, I'm gonna ride this momentum
all the
way to m'next race!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! Spot on, Trainer. I can't let my

standards go slipp'n now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gotta do some serious train'n so I can
get another
win next time!
